items.quote: You should prefer the OAuth 2.0 flow if building an app for multiple workspaces.
items.why: Quote covers OAuth for multi-workspace apps only; not api_key or bearer_token.

items.quote: If you only need a token for a single workspace, you can generate an API key in the developer settings page of your apps.
items.why: Quote covers single-workspace API key from developer settings; OAuth and bearer not stated.

items.quote: Yes. The Free plan costs nothing for up to three users.
items.why: Quote is about Free plan pricing; says nothing about admin approval gating credentials.

items.quote: An unpublished app can be installed in up to 25 workspaces.
items.why: Quote is about unpublished app install limit; no mention of admin approval.

items.quote: Attio provides a public REST API which exchanges JSON over HTTPS.
items.why: Quote confirms public REST API with JSON over HTTPS; breadth claim not stated.

items.quote: Attio MCP is Attio's hosted MCP server that gives AI tools secure access to your Attio workspace.
items.why: Quote states hosted MCP server from Attio, implying existence and vendor-official; URL not shown.

items.quote: Attio MCP uses OAuth authentication, so you simply log in with your Attio account—no API keys required.
items.why: Quote shows OAuth login for Attio MCP; implies server exists but URL and official status not stated.

items.quote: Attio is the platform that builds pipeline, advances deals, and grows accounts around the clock.
items.why: Quote mentions pipeline, deals, accounts; does not say customizable, AI-native CRM.
